channel.title: AI GridWatch — Nevada data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Nevada, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Nye County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Countywide moratorium on new commercial data-center applications, approved unanimously after the Nye County Water District's governing board raised Pahrump Valley water-supply concerns; stays in place until a regulatory ordinance is adopted rather than a fixed date.

item.title: Reno: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Extended 6-1 through Aug 2027 while permanent rules are drafted

item.title: Henderson: data center moratorium — Rejected
item.description: Council rejected the mayor's 180-day pause after nearly two hours of public comment favouring it, opting for code changes and project-by-project development agreements instead
